basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old comic book enthusiast and disc golf aficionado hailing from Warner Robins, Georgia. By day, I work as an IT specialist at a local tech firm, but my true passion lies in the colorful pages of DC Comics and the strategic throws on a disc golf course. I've been reading comics since I was a kid, with a particular fondness for the DC universe, though I'm always open to exploring new stories. When I'm not diving into the latest comic book series or perfecting my backhand throw, you can likely find me playing 'Metro Exodus' or revisiting episodes of 'Exosquad'. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch break or late at night after I unwind from the day. Currently, I'm happily single and enjoy the freedom to pursue my many hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep-seated knowledge of DC Comics, acquired through years of reading and collecting. My understanding of IT systems comes from both formal education—a bachelor's degree in Computer Science—and a decade of hands-on experience in the field. I've also developed a good understanding of disc golf through countless hours on the course and participating in local tournaments.
